interpretation: Three selected directory pages display a generic last-bid-day label while their own descriptions refer to an application/participation process. This is a source-internal stage ambiguity candidate, not a confirmed incorrect date, deadline, legal conflict, competitor error rate or willingness to pay. Two DIS dates may represent long-lived qualification windows rather than single tender submissions.
limitations: Selected from targeted search, no population denominator, possible date-label semantics and publisher normalization; primary notices were inaccessible without login or JavaScript challenge. Do not extrapolate prevalence or send supplier deadline alerts.
next_validation: Predeclare a bounded consecutive cohort of negotiated procedures and DIS notices, retrieve primary source with authorization, record stage classification and date semantics, then measure consented supplier decision outcomes.
